name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
instructions: Toast the bread slices until they are golden brown and crispy.
While the bread is toasting, mash the ripe avocado in a bowl and season with salt and pepper.

Fill a small saucepan with water and bring it to a simmer. Crack the eggs, one at a time, into a small bowl and gently slide them into the simmering water. Poach the eggs for about 3-4 minutes for a soft yolk.
Spread the mashed avocado onto the toasted bread slices.
Using a slotted spoon, carefully remove the poached eggs from the water and place one on top of each avocado toast.
Season with additional salt and pepper, and add any optional toppings if desired.
Serve the avocado toast with poached egg immediately. Enjoy!
